skill.name: error-handling-gate
skill.description: Reviews application code for graceful error handling, useful user feedback, logging, cleanup, and edge cases.
skill.summary: Review failure paths before release and surface actionable error handling warnings.
skill.author: DanielPodolsky

content.value_statement: Unhandled errors create confusing user experiences and weak production diagnostics. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to review failure paths, feedback, logs, cleanup, and edge cases.
actual_capabilities: Checks async operations for try/catch, catch handlers, and cleanup.
Identifies empty catch blocks and silent failure risks.
Evaluates user-facing error messages for clarity and next steps.
Reviews logging guidance for context and sensitive data concerns.
Provides pass or warning response templates for review results.
limitations: Does not execute tests or verify runtime behavior.
Does not replace application-specific monitoring design.
Requires code context to identify exact failure paths.
Reports warnings instead of blocking a release.

use_cases.title: Check UI Failure States
use_cases.description: Review form submissions, loading states, and user messages before a frontend change ships.

use_cases.title: Review Service Failures
use_cases.description: Evaluate API, database, and third-party failure paths for logging, recovery, and clear responses.

use_cases.title: Run Release Gate
use_cases.description: Apply a consistent warning-based checklist before approving feature work for release.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Error Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a small change.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the error-handling-gate skill to review this change. Identify missing error handling and explain any warnings in plain language.

prompt_templates.title: User Feedback Check
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply the error-handling-gate skill to the visible error states. Check whether users know what happened and what to do next.

prompt_templates.title: Production Debuggability Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the error-handling-gate skill to review logging, sensitive data risks, and debugging context for the main failure paths.

prompt_templates.title: Release Readiness Gate
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the error-handling-gate skill across this feature. Return PASS or WARNING with locations, questions, severity, and recommended fixes.

output_examples.input: Review a profile save flow that catches errors but only shows Error.
output_examples.output: WARNING: User feedback is too generic. Ask what the user can do next and confirm the failure is logged safely.

output_examples.input: Review a data load flow with retry, friendly copy, logging, and loading cleanup.
output_examples.output: PASS: The main failure path includes recovery guidance, production visibility, and cleanup of pending UI state.

output_examples.input: Review a checkout integration with third-party payment errors.
output_examples.output: WARNING: Separate declined payment, network failure, and unknown errors so users receive accurate guidance.

best_practices: Review the user experience for every likely failure path.
Pair error logging with context, but exclude secrets and personal data.
Confirm cleanup paths reset loading, disabled, and pending states.
anti_patterns: Accepting empty catch blocks because the happy path works.
Showing raw exception messages to end users.
Treating one generic error as enough for every failure.

faq.question: Does this skill block releases?
faq.answer: No. It produces PASS or WARNING guidance so teams can decide what must change before release.

faq.question: Can it find every runtime error?
faq.answer: No. It reviews available code and reasoning, but it does not execute tests or simulate production traffic.

faq.question: What code works best with this skill?
faq.answer: It works best with async flows, UI actions, API calls, database operations, and third-party integrations.

faq.question: Does it review security?
faq.answer: It can flag sensitive data in logs and technical error exposure, but it is not a full security audit.

faq.question: Can Claude Code use this skill?
faq.answer: Yes. The guidance is compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code review workflows.

faq.question: What output should I expect?
faq.answer: Expect a PASS or WARNING result with concerns, locations when available, review questions, and suggested fixes.
